high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Google search result page for the documentary "Putin's Palace." The document is dated 2021 and is described as a Russian documentary film by the Anti-Corruption Foundation. The director is listed as Alexei Navalny, and the production company is also the Anti-Corruption Foundation. The original title of the film is given in Russian: "Дворец для Путина. История самой большой взятки," which translates to "Palace for Putin. The Story of the Largest Bribe." The IMDb rating for the film is 8.9 out
